7337

"B"
Misc. 115/36           Sinza
                  28th March,             36.

1

Bursting of a test tube containing an irritant
liquid in the Grand Theatre.

At 3. p.m. 28/3/36, Mr. F. Sonnleitner, Manager of
the Grand Theatre informed the station by telephone that
a tear-gas bomb had burst in the Cinema.

A party of Police under Inspector Bishop attended.
Detective Police were posted at entrances and exits, and
enquiries were commenced by D.D.O. "B", D.S.I. Crawford,
D.S. Mant and C.D.S. 309.

Shortly after the 2.30 p.m. performance started,
featuring Harold Lloyd in "Milky Way", people sitting in
the stalls (right side front) had to move on account of
tear-gas fumes suddenly pervading the place. About
thirty people were moved upstairs by the Management and
the immediate area cleared.

Attendant searched the floor and found the top
part of a test tube containing a few drops of the tear-
gas fluid. The test tube appears to have been the
ordinary 5" variety sealed over a bunsen burner and broken
short. The piece discovered was about 2" long: it was
found in the fourth row from the stage.

The management adopted what measures it could to
counteract the effect of the gas, but it reached to the
back of the theatre.

There was no panic and as far as is known no one
left the theatre before the arrival of the Police. The

“B”
杂项 115/36           新闸
                  1936年3月28日

1

大光明戏院装有刺激性液体的试管破裂事件。

1936年3月28日下午3时，大光明戏院经理 F. Sonnleitner 先生电话通知本分局，称戏院内有一枚催泪弹爆裂。

由 Bishop 巡官率领的一队警员前往处置。侦探警察被部署在出入口，并由“B”区副侦探督察长、侦探副督察长 Crawford、侦探警佐 Mant 及刑事侦缉警士 309 号开始进行调查。

下午2时30分放映由哈罗德·劳埃德（Harold Lloyd）主演的《银河》（Milky Way）开始后不久，坐在正厅前排右侧的观众因现场突然弥漫催泪气体而被迫移动。约三十人被管理层疏散至楼上，并清空了附近区域。

服务员搜查了地面，发现了一个装有数滴催泪液体的试管上部。该试管似乎是用本生灯封口的普通5英寸规格试管，且短处断裂。发现的碎片长约2英寸，位于距离舞台第四排的位置。

管理层采取了力所能及的措施以抵消气体影响，但气体仍扩散至戏院后部。

现场未发生恐慌，据所知，在警察到达之前无人离开戏院。

    Three theories are held at present as to the cause
of the incident.
1.  It represents a protest against the showing of
    Harold Lloyd films, which in the past have offended
    Chinese susceptibilities.
2.  The incident was a practical joke.
|| 3.  The whole affair was an accident, i.e. Someone

    it from a pocket.

number 3.

杂项 115/36           新闸

1（第2页）

演出并未中断。
    经理称，他在演出开始前曾看到四名学生在一起交谈，并指出了其中两人，即中法工学院（Institute Technique Franco-Chinois）的程祖炳（Ching Zau Bing）和羅正（Loh Tseng），此二人接受了具名人的讯问。他们的陈述令人满意，且无法认定其与本案有关。
    目前对于事件起因有三种推测：
1.  这是对放映哈罗德·劳埃德电影的一种抗议，此类电影过去曾冒犯中国人的情感。
2.  这是一次恶作剧。
|| 3.  整件事纯属意外，即某人随身携带该试管，不慎从口袋中掉落。
    关于第2和第3点，需注意当时有多名
（批：将在学校进行调查。C） || 外国学校儿童在场观看演出，且座位距离发现破碎试管的位置不远。
    目前看来，最可行的推测似乎是第3种。
    气体的刺激作用极强，刺激眼睛，影响视力并导致流泪。经检验，该液体挥发性很强，短时间内已从破碎试管中完全蒸发。在这方面，其作用类似于

    A thorough search of the cinema was made after
the performance, with the aid of the Eveready lantern
recently issued to stations, but although it was
exceedingly useful nothing further was discovered that
would assist the police.
    Enquiries are proceeding with a view to tracing
the source of the fluid and test tube.
